LanguageData.CBF_AD_NewTip: Add an existing piece as an ancient danger. It goes into CBF_AncientDanger and can be moved to another category afterwards. New pieces are drawn in the Piece tab.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_PickOne: Pick an ancient danger on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_CategoryTip: Categories under CBF_AncientDanger count in every scenario. Categories under CBF_AncientDangerScenario only count in scenarios that name them.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_WeightTip: How often this piece is rolled against the others. The weight comes from the category and is set in the Categories tab.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_SiteText: RimWorld rolls a site of 15 to 20 cells per side next to rock. The piece is stamped in the middle.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_SiteSometimes: Larger than 15 cells: only chosen when the rolled site is big enough. Turning counts if the piece may turn.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_SiteNever: Larger than 20 cells: never chosen. The check shows this as an error.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_GuardAwakeTip: This list does not have the role Sleeper. Its pawns stand guard awake.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_UsedEverywhere: Every scenario that does not set ancient dangers to None.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_UsedNowhere: No scenario names {0} yet. Add it in the Scenarios tab.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_LetterNote: RimWorld's own letter, the same for CBF pieces.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_SleeperText: Pawns of a list with the role Sleeper lie asleep at their spawn anchor. They wake when the colony comes close or makes noise, then attack. Mechs and insects get their own faction, people a hostile one.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_CheckSometimes: Check: {0} is larger than 15 × 15 and only fits some sites.
LanguageData.CBF_AD_CheckNever: Check: {0} is larger than 20 × 20 and can never be placed.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PickOne: Pick a scenario on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_HeadYours: Your scenario · set in RimWorld's scenario editor
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_YoursText: Scenarios you made in game are files, not defs. Set the ancient dangers there, in RimWorld's scenario editor, with the part Ancient dangers (CBF). Here you only see the result.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_ModeText_VanillaAndOwn: RimWorld's ancient dangers and the CBF pieces are rolled together.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_ModeText_OwnOnly: Only CBF pieces. RimWorld's own ancient danger is only built as a fallback.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_ModeText_None: No ancient dangers on any map of this scenario.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_VanillaWeightNote: against the weight of each CBF piece
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_VanillaWeightTip: How often RimWorld's own ancient danger is rolled against the CBF pieces.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_ExtraCategoriesTip: Categories under CBF_AncientDangerScenario whose pieces also count in this scenario. Pieces under CBF_AncientDanger always count.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_NoScenarioCategories: There is no further category under CBF_AncientDangerScenario. Create one in the Categories tab with that parent.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_FallbackText: Build RimWorld's ancient danger when no own piece fits the site
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_FallbackOff: Build RimWorld's ancient danger when no own piece fits the site (only with Own only)
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_FallbackTip: On: the site gets RimWorld's ancient danger. Off: the site stays empty.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PoolNone: Nothing. The step is skipped on every map of this scenario.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PoolEmpty: No CBF piece yet. Add pieces in the Dangers tab.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PoolNote: Only pieces that fit the rolled site take part in the roll. RimWorld's own fits every site.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PoolFallbackOn: When the rolled site is too small for every own piece, RimWorld's own ancient danger is built instead.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_PoolFallbackOff: When the rolled site is too small for every own piece, the site stays empty.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_VanillaEditor: Same setting in RimWorld's scenario editor
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_VanillaEditorText: Players set it there for their own scenarios. For scenarios of other mods, Save here writes a patch into your mod that only applies when that mod is loaded.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_FootYours: Change it in RimWorld's scenario editor.
LanguageData.CBF_Sz_NoProject: Open a project first. The patch goes into its mod folder.
